_meta.description: Ingredient/dietary guide for UWFS (University of Waterloo Food Services) dining locations, compiled from the 22 PDF ingredient guides.
_meta.important_disclaimer: halal_labeled and allergens come directly from the PDFs. vegetarian / vegan / contains_pork / contains_alcohol are INFERRED automatically from the listed ingredients and are not official UWFS labels. Always verify with staff at point of ordering.

field_definitions.dietary.halal_labeled: true only if the source explicitly says 'halal' for the item (in its name or ingredients). false means 'not labeled halal', NOT 'haram'.
field_definitions.dietary.vegetarian: true = no meat/fish/gelatin found in ingredients (dairy and eggs allowed). false = animal flesh/fish/gelatin found. null = cannot tell (no ingredient info, or contains rennet/worcestershire that may be animal-derived).
field_definitions.dietary.vegan: true = vegetarian and no dairy/egg/honey found. false = contains dairy, egg, honey, or meat. null = cannot tell.
field_definitions.dietary.contains_pork: 'yes' = pork/bacon/ham/lard etc. listed; 'possible' = ambiguous processed meat (sausage, pepperoni, salami, chorizo, gelatin) not labeled halal; 'none_listed' otherwise.
field_definitions.dietary.contains_alcohol: true if an alcohol ingredient is listed (wine, beer, whisky, rum, tequila, 'ethyl alcohol' in vanilla extract, etc.).
field_definitions.dietary.basis: Short explanation of how vegetarian/vegan was decided.
field_definitions.allergens: contains / may_contain lists come from the PDF 'Contains' / 'May contain' statements; shared_fryer is true if the PDF mentions a shared fryer.
field_definitions.ingredients: Ingredient text from the PDF. Multi-part items (e.g. sandwiches, poutines) list each component; different components/variants are separated by ' | '.
field_definitions.item_ids: Recipe / item numbers printed in the PDF (may be empty).
field_definitions.healthScore: Estimated overall healthiness of the item from 0 (least healthy) to 1 (most healthy), rounded to 3 decimals. INFERRED by a heuristic from the listed ingredients, item name and menu section - NOT an official UWFS rating and NOT based on nutrition data (calories, fat, sodium and fibre are not in the source). Rewards vegetables, fruit, legumes, whole grains, nuts/seeds and lean protein; penalizes added sugar, refined flour, fried/breaded items, processed meats, butter/cream/cheese/shortening and heavy use of additives. Portion size is not considered. Items with no ingredient list (plain produce) are scored from their name.

notes: Note: Choice of salad dressing may impact allergens and dietary symbols. Please check individual salad dressings for ingredients.
